title: China-to-UAE Industrial Motor Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Motor scope and IE efficiency classes
rows.target_requirement: UAE industrial AC motors in ESMA ECAS scope are assessed against UAE/GSO standards that adopt or align with IEC practice. GSO 60034 / IEC 60034 is the motor performance family, and IEC 60034-30-1 provides IE efficiency class references used for three-phase motors.
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly relies on GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes, aligned in concept with IEC 60034-30-1, plus GB 12665 for cooling and CCC as a baseline for motors below 1 kV when in CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: A Chinese IE class statement does not by itself establish UAE ECAS conformity. The UAE file should map the exact motor scope, rating, pole count, and efficiency class to GSO/IEC 60034 evidence accepted by ESMA.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where the industrial AC motor falls within ESMA ECAS regulated scope
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where GB 18613 and CCC scope apply to the China-market motor

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat GSO/IEC 60034 evidence as the UAE-facing basis, not the Chinese GB or CCC file alone.

source.publisher: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology

rows.target_requirement: The UAE importer or manufacturer must classify whether the motor is a regulated industrial product under ECAS, then submit the applicable test reports, declarations, labels, and technical file through the MOIAT/ESMA conformity route.
rows.china_equivalent: China-market classification is usually made against the CCC catalogue and applicable GB standards. Motors below 1 kV may use CCC scope analysis, GB 18613 efficiency evidence, and GB 12665 cooling documentation as the domestic baseline.
rows.gap: CCC catalogue classification is not portable to the UAE. ECAS scope, HS code, rated voltage, intended use, and whether controls or wireless modules are integrated should be checked separately for the UAE.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory classification step before UAE import or placing on market
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory classification step before China-market sale where CCC catalogue applies

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Reclassify the motor under UAE ECAS and utility context instead of assuming China CCC scope answers the UAE question.

source.publisher: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology

rows.target_requirement: UAE energy-efficiency policy is administered through ESMA/MOIAT conformity programmes and UAE green-building policy. For industrial AC motors, the expected reference direction is GSO/IEC 60034 and IEC 60034-30-1 IE classes, with MEPS development aligned to the ESMA energy-efficiency agenda.
rows.china_equivalent: China uses GB 18613 as the common industrial motor MEPS baseline, with IE class concepts aligned to IEC 60034-30-1. GB 12665 and CCC documentation may appear in the China domestic compliance file for motors below 1 kV in CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: China GB 18613 evidence may be useful background but does not replace UAE ECAS evidence. The UAE file should show the IE class and measured efficiency against GSO/IEC expectations accepted for the ECAS submission.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where energy-efficiency requirements are included in the applicable ECAS or UAE green-building route
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China-market motors within GB 18613 scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not treat a China GB 18613 efficiency claim as a UAE approval; build a UAE ECAS-ready efficiency file against GSO/IEC references.

source.publisher: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology

rows.target_requirement: UAE low-voltage distribution is commonly 400/230 V, 50 Hz. DEWA and Abu Dhabi distribution utilities expect equipment connected to the grid to be suitable for the UAE supply. Three-phase motors should therefore show a 400 V 50 Hz rating or documented compatibility.
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic three-phase motors are commonly rated for 380 V, 50 Hz. The frequency matches the UAE, but the three-phase voltage differs from the UAE 400 V supply.
rows.gap: A 380 V-only nameplate creates a UAE documentation gap. The exporter should provide 400 V 50 Hz type-test data, acceptable voltage tolerance, thermal performance, insulation suitability, and updated nameplate information.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for grid-connected UAE installations and utility acceptance
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for domestic China rating evidence at 380 V 50 Hz where applicable

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] A 380 V China nameplate should be converted into a documented 400 V 50 Hz UAE rating before ECAS and project acceptance are pursued.

rows.requirement: Efficiency test method and technical file
rows.target_requirement: A UAE ECAS technical file should include efficiency test evidence, nameplate data, rating conditions, and declarations that match GSO/IEC 60034 expectations. Testing should be traceable to a laboratory and method acceptable to the ESMA/MOIAT conformity route.
rows.china_equivalent: China efficiency files often rely on GB/T 1032 test methods and GB 18613 classification. CCC files for motors below 1 kV in scope may include domestic test reports, factory inspection, and certificate data.
china_standards: CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: GB/T 1032 reports may not be accepted without mapping to the GSO/IEC method required by the UAE certification body. The technical file should avoid unsupported equivalence claims and should show the actual test method, load points, voltage, frequency, and uncertainty.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory documentation element for ECAS certification where efficiency is in scope
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory documentation element for China MEPS and CCC scope where applicable

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare efficiency evidence in the GSO/IEC format expected by the UAE certification body instead of submitting an unmapped China domestic report alone.

rows.requirement: EMC for motors, drives, and controls
rows.target_requirement: UAE conformity files for industrial motors should address EMC where the motor is supplied with a drive, controller, inverter, sensor, or electronic assembly. UAE practice uses GSO/UAE standards based on IEC/EN EMC methods, and the ECAS file may require evidence of emissions and immunity compliance.
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic files may include GB EMC standards for drives or electronic controls and CCC evidence where products fall in CCC scope. A bare motor file may focus on GB 18613, GB 12665, and CCC baseline documents rather than a UAE-style EMC package.
china_standards: GB EMC standards for drives or controls where applicable
CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: A China domestic motor file may omit EMC evidence needed for UAE ECAS when electronics are integrated. The UAE submission should distinguish a passive motor from a motor-drive package and include EMC test reports for the actual configuration shipped.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where EMC standards are part of the ECAS route or where electronic assemblies are supplied
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China EMC or CCC scope applies to the supplied configuration

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For motor-drive packages, include UAE/GSO/IEC EMC evidence for the shipped assembly; a China motor-only file is usually incomplete.

source.publisher: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology

rows.requirement: TRA approval for wireless or radio-enabled motor products
rows.target_requirement: If the motor package includes a wireless module, telemetry unit, remote-control receiver, cellular modem, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or other radio equipment, UAE telecommunications type approval may be required through the Telecommunications Regulatory Authority route before import or sale.
target_standards: UAE TRA telecommunications equipment type approval
rows.china_equivalent: China may require SRRC radio approval, network access approval, or CCC-related evidence for certain radio-enabled controls. Those approvals are domestic China approvals and do not replace UAE TRA type approval.
china_standards: SRRC where radio modules are in China scope
CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: A motor with remote monitoring can become a telecommunications product for UAE purposes. The UAE file should list every radio module and frequency band and should separate TRA approval from ESMA ECAS motor conformity.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where radio or telecommunications equipment is integrated
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China radio or telecom approvals apply to the integrated module

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Wireless motor packages need a separate UAE TRA/TDRA check; China radio approvals and CCC do not substitute.

source.publisher: UAE Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority

rows.requirement: ECAS certificate before UAE market placement
rows.target_requirement: Regulated industrial motors require an Emirates Conformity Assessment Scheme certificate before UAE import, distribution, or sale. The application is handled through the MOIAT/ESMA conformity route and normally requires product identification, test reports, labels, declarations, and an accepted conformity assessment body.
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic market access for motors may rely on CCC for motors below 1 kV in CCC scope, GB 18613 efficiency evidence, and GB 12665 documentation. These documents support China-market compliance but do not constitute UAE import approval.
china_standards: CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: CCC is not recognized as ECAS. A UAE importer should obtain an ECAS certificate and maintain a UAE-facing technical file before shipment, rather than presenting China-only certificates at customs.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for regulated products before UAE market placement
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China-market products within CCC and GB scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Obtain ECAS separately for UAE shipment; China CCC and GB evidence are supporting inputs only, not UAE market authorization.

source.publisher: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology

rows.requirement: ECAS mark, labels, and Arabic/English documentation
rows.target_requirement: Once certified, regulated products may need ECAS marking and UAE-compliant product identification, importer details, rating data, and user documentation. For industrial motors, the nameplate should match the ECAS file, including voltage, frequency, efficiency class, power, duty, protection, and manufacturer identity.
rows.china_equivalent: China nameplates and documentation often reflect GB standards, CCC mark requirements, Chinese domestic ratings, and Chinese importer or manufacturer details. These may not include UAE importer identity, 400 V rating, or ECAS mark information.
rows.gap: A China domestic nameplate can fail UAE review if it lacks ECAS-linked identification or shows 380 V-only ratings. Update labels and manuals to match the UAE certificate and actual market importer.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where ECAS marking and UAE labelling controls apply
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China CCC marking and GB nameplate requirements apply

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Align labels, manuals, importer data, and nameplate ratings with the ECAS certificate before shipment.

source.publisher: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology

rows.requirement: Utility and project approval by DEWA or Abu Dhabi distributors
rows.target_requirement: For motors used in building services, pumps, HVAC, industrial sites, or grid-connected equipment, project approval may require DEWA, ADDC, AADC, consultant, or authority acceptance in addition to ECAS. Utility review may check electrical ratings, protection, installation method, and compatibility with 400/230 V 50 Hz supply.
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic project files may reference GB electrical installation rules, local utility expectations, CCC, GB 18613, and GB 12665. These do not address UAE utility connection review.
china_standards: CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: ECAS is not the same as site acceptance. A motor may be certified but still need project-specific review for protection coordination, starting current, harmonics from drives, enclosure rating, and utility connection conditions.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where utility or project approval applies
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China local utility or project acceptance applies

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat UAE utility approval as a separate project gate from ECAS certification, especially for high-power motors and motor-drive systems.

rows.requirement: Electrical safety under GSO/IEC motor standards
rows.target_requirement: UAE ECAS review for industrial AC motors should include electrical safety evidence aligned with applicable UAE/GSO standards based on IEC motor practice. The file should address insulation system, temperature rise, enclosure protection, earthing, rating, duty, and safe installation instructions.
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic motor safety files commonly include GB standards, GB 12665 for cooling, GB 18613 efficiency evidence, and CCC documentation for motors below 1 kV in CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: A CCC or GB safety file may not map directly to UAE/GSO/IEC safety expectations. The UAE certification body may require IEC-style test reports, English documentation, and nameplate data matching 400 V 50 Hz operation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where ECAS safety assessment applies
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China GB and CCC safety assessment applies

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare a UAE/GSO/IEC safety file for the exact motor rating and configuration; China CCC evidence alone is not enough.

source.publisher: UAE Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology

rows.target_requirement: Motors used in hazardous areas, outdoor pumping stations, desert heat, marine environments, or industrial plants may require additional UAE project or authority acceptance beyond baseline ECAS. The file should address ingress protection, ambient temperature, cooling method, corrosion protection, and hazardous-area certification where applicable.
target_standards: Project specifications from DEWA, ADDC, or AADC where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic files may show GB 12665 cooling evidence, GB motor safety evidence, CCC for motors below 1 kV in scope, and separate explosion-proof certification where required for China hazardous areas.
china_standards: CCC for <1 kV motors in CCC scope
rows.gap: Environmental and hazardous-area acceptability is use-case specific. UAE purchasers or authorities may reject a motor that is ECAS-certified but not documented for high ambient temperature, outdoor ingress protection, corrosion, or explosive-atmosphere service.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where project specification, hazardous-area use, or local authority approval applies
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China hazardous-area, CCC, or GB project requirements apply

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Check the actual UAE installation environment separately from baseline ECAS, especially for outdoor, utility, and hazardous-area motors.
